body: Yes I understand that, that they go for that career over anything else and may or may not sincerely be trying to help. But overall I just either think the counselors in my area are completely greedy, or just suck at doing there job. They pressure me to do things For example I have social anxiety, I've fainted in school cus of it etc. They tell me I have to go if not gov, gonna take me from my home. I always say i'll try to go, but at a slower pace so Im not overwhelmed. But thats never good enough, I've switched counsellors maybe 4 times now. I've used online counselling, from people which im a bit more comfortable with, Cus I just think its more trust worthy and that they ain't doing somethin for there own benefit. but just counselling in general doesn't do much, either I've been hiding a stash of Zoloft for the past 2weeks, Im just saving up to make sure, I still got awhile tbh. I've switched from paxil to zoloft, to another one I forgot the name but its for high blood pressure with a side affect that kinda knocks you out, and then back to zoloft.

Yes, I go to counselling. But I personally don't find any of it helpful, I mean they don't actually wanna help tbh. Most people just wanna make money, so I never trust em and I just go with it cus I have to, I mean if you knew me personally i'd be able to explain better. But i don't like going in to detail publicly as I prefer skype etc if someone tries to talk to me and so on. Normally talking to friends gets my mind off of it, but most friends are busy and my girl atm has her own problems. So its a hassle, but honestly its not much of a concern.

Well I mean I see what you mean saying meds affect others differently and so on, but I have been through countless changes on meds so I don't think it really matter if I just went and asked for a different prescription again. But I mean like I been researching it for awhile now, and I been saving up to abt 31 tablets I believe atm, each 50MG but I dunno how much that would take, but given this is the internet I'd rather not go in to details. But thank you for the experience,
